newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices jump, volume steady.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices jump, volume steady.

text.p: Prices on the Istanbul gold exchange rose on Tuesday in line with European trends and volume was little changed at 720 kilos after Monday's 798 kilos, dealers said.
Gold ended at $355.00 an ounce and 1,424,000 lira per gram, up from $350.70 and 1,408,100 lira on Monday.
Dealers said higher gold prices caused banks to shy away from arbitrage deals which usually push up the volume sharply.
The bulk of the trade took place in the morning when 450 kilos were done, and 72.2 percent of the total was registered in lira terms.
